// diagnostic E2725

Jet.GrammarUnprintable

This grammar's `print` cannot write this rule

What

This grammar's `print` cannot write this rule

Why

A grammar's `print` writes a value as text that parses back to the same value, and here no text it could write would.

Fix

Keep the token in a labeled field, or give it fixed text.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.GrammarUnprintable: Tests/UI/grammar_unprintable.stderr.

Error: Jet.GrammarUnprintable: The token `NUM` is kept in no field and has no fixed text, so a value cannot print it
  --> Tests/UI/grammar_unprintable.jet:6:19
    |
  6 |     limit : 'max' NUM ;
    |                   ^
 Why: A grammar's `print` writes a value as text that parses back to the same value, and here no text it could write would
 Fix: Label it, as `value=NUM`, so the value keeps the text it matched
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.GrammarUnprintable
